ruleDefinitions.name: User Discovery And Export Via Get-ADUser Cmdlet
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the Get-ADUser cmdlet to collect user information and output it to a file

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*Get\\-ADUser\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-Filter\\ \\*.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\>\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\|\\ Select\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Out\\-File.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Set\\-Content.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Add\\-Content.*"))))
